property_summary: Scheduling an operation with delay >= minDelay makes it pending (timestamp > DONE_TIMESTAMP) and it cannot be scheduled twice (second schedule reverts).

If execute is called by an address without EXECUTOR_ROLE and EXECUTOR_ROLE is not open, the call must revert; otherwise if executor role is open, execute must succeed when operation is ready and caller has role or role is open.
If an operation id is scheduled with delay >= minDelay, then getTimestamp(id) > _DONE_TIMESTAMP (i.e., isOperationPending) until it is executed or cancelled.
If execute is called on a ready operation by an address that has EXECUTOR_ROLE, the operation becomes done (isOperationDone returns true).
